asr.full_text: Hello I'm Crypto Ally and I hope you all are well. I have a good news to announce. A partnership has been made with Stromblock, and Phantom you know about Stromblock. Let me tell you I'll have to speak about it. I know some of you don't know Phantom yet. I'm going to show what exactly it is. Regarding Phantom it's simple. It is a virtual machine that works on with EVM, an Ethereum network that's fast, really fast, one second in order to do evolving and secure transactions. Which takes advantage of consensus AVFT protocol without authorization. For Fantom transactions, as I said,, one second and about a cent for the limit Fantome accepted to subsidize some of the rewards of the knot through the FTM token log 3 so for me, in my case like other people out there who are going to pair knots with StromBloc We're going to have a reward as usual in StromBloc And from FTM are going to give us a reward as usual as the Stromblock and the FTM will also provide us as a reward FTM Stromblock also plans to develop innovative validation initiatives and Pulse of knot on Phantom and the new has been announced here on Stromblock's official website and then we can see here what is Stromblock, and if you do not know it an easier way to deploy a nut Today, Strom costs more, its still good, I know its a lot of money 634 USD, wow, the reaction for the Nobel is really nice Yes it is expensive to return today. $6340 for one knot. But, that amount you get approximately at $0.10. It doesn't count with real numbers of 0.09 or 0.04, right?! It has you as a reward. $63 per day to operate 1 StrumBlock knot. I put several of my profits and the cryptos who go nowhere in this project there and it's like that at least I am able to work with a passive income, with a passive income with the token. I am already able to work with a passive income and I do not have to worry about that. To put the data of the project into perspective, if you take your money that you will be able I put many of my profits in crypto that would nowhere to go in this project. And at least that way, I'm now able to work with a passive income that I hope will bring me freedom soon, what I told you about myself that I wanted to retire in 9-months maximum. Big news here. Very happy to be a part of it. Not too late to join, by the way stromblock will add between 1 and 2 partnerships with me Currently you can create a node on ethereum 1.0 that will switch to 2.0 for sure Then Polygon our second partnership here which is not yet deployed and will is sent to the 2nd spot sentinel as the first position since the start of the trade and now as I said at 3rd position we are lucky to have the new egg I just wanted to mention that I will keep you up to date on essential things And dont forget to attach a NFT to your nut You can do that, I bought a silver one and I win with this currency because it is cheaper than the first one Think well before investing in it For example, it still gives like a $30 extra per day just because I bought a Newstay. Remember this before investing. We are talking about serious business here. And I'm invested, and I have a good capital and also many players. Their stocks are in this. The stock market cap is still not even at $100 million. We just hit a 100 million or 104 million. The stock market cap's a lot more possibilities like I said they want 50 protocols we only have 3, 1,2 protocols per month And they want 1 million nœuds and we are currently at how many nœuds we will see on the App here we will see that right now before leaving Ok application Allnode 77,617 Let's have a look to the app 77.617 nodes as you can see 77.617 A total of 1000 nodes per day Like in the example He created his 4th, his 5th, his 6th Then his 1st, His 4th, His 2st, His 3rd Everyone's trying to create nodes And yeah, everyone's enjoying this opportunity create knots. They are taking advantage of the opportunity they have. Look at him, WOW! 52, 53... This is really a lot of money! 60 knots! Do you know what it represents, 60 knots? I can tell you exactly! 60 knots x a reward of 60 dollars. It's 3600 dollars per day, no jokes. Have not said that the is 3,600 dollars a day. No joke! We don't want to say the guy is going to make 3,600 a day, but he's going to accumulate accumulate accumulate... ...create more nes! 50, 60, 70! You can put 200 nes, per wallet MetaMask No Limit you double what you have, in each 110 days Finally! The reward here is .10 x 29 hours Actually it's .0094 x4x24h, 7000 pairs on ETH. ok, i leave it on it, think about it, i know it's a good sum, i don't have any commission to talk about. I'm gonna do without it, i'm happy it's up to you, it's not in my court. And if you decide, yes it's very expensive. The price was around $200. I even spent $300 on it because of the fact that it sold out last week. I'm sitting here for about 30 days. I could even go back under $300 later in August. And now, the price goes down. Let's catch up on a future video, bye!
